values.value: I hereby confirm that all information provided in my housing application is true, accurate, and complete. I acknowledge that selecting a housing unit does not constitute final approval or entitlement, and that the reservation remains subject to verification of my eligibility and compliance with the applicable requirements of the Abu Dhabi Housing Authority. I undertake to notify the Authority of any change affecting my eligibility and understand that inaccurate or misleading information may result in the cancellation of the reservation and any related procedures.
